predictor: Original Euclidean5NN, three search folds, fitting-only minmax
candidate_rule: Unselected affordable attributes; positive internal gain ranking when available; otherwise same original maximal signed-prediction-gain bridge; stop at internal full reference or no affordable attribute
prediction_rank: Largest positive internal improvement/cost, ties cost then index
guidance_rank: Among positive prediction candidates, prioritize positive dependency gain/cost; if none positive dependency, same prediction rank fallback
differences_from_formal: Budget-constrained selection ablation: same internal full-reference stop and signed bridge as original guided candidate; common cost cap added; no deletion/exchange refinement; may stop infeasible when budget exhausted
fairness: Same acquisition budget caps and rules except positive candidate rank; actual spending, cardinality and evaluation work may differ
audit: All six selections per split saved with hashes before evaluation; no audit use in selection, no outer test, no retuning
